caption:
The video captures a bearded man in a black “HR” t-shirt standing in the foreground under a corrugated metal roof, laughing with his head tilted downward. A grey cap with sunglasses perched on it shades his face, while a second man in a dark green “HR” shirt and cap smiles beside him. Behind them, a parked truck with a crane arm marked “SWL 10t” sits near a man in a white shirt, and a dry open field stretches away to the right under bright sunlight.

As the clip continues, the foreground man lifts his gaze toward the camera, then turns his head to his right, still smiling broadly. His right hand rises into a loose pointing gesture near his shoulder, and the cap appears darker at times. The camera moves so the truck and white-shirted man drift out, revealing a man in pink, a seated man in orange, and another in a black hat. The green-shirted man becomes partly hidden, his expression turning more neutral as the laughing continues.
